_meta.notes: 테마 = 레이어 조합(6.2). 배경을 통째로 만들지 않고 하늘/먼산/중경/전경/날씨/조명 레이어를 조합·필터로 변주. 에셋 키는 assets manifest(구현)와 1:1(확장자만 다름). 설원/성벽은 2순위(23.11)이므로 tier-1(평원·숲·야경)만 활성.
_meta.revision: 2026-08-11: field midground = castle+tree (was far_mountain); night keeps house/moon. Fixes night-only house repeating in the field theme. | 2026-08-12: second tree species (mid_pine_green) in field/forest; mid_pine stays the snow-theme conifer per GDD 23.10 | 2026-08-12: mid_castle removed from the field theme — a castle recurring across open meadow made no sense in-fiction (user feedback). Field midground is trees only; density and depth variety now come from BackgroundLayer rather than from adding landmark props. | 2026-08-12: mid_tree_oak/mid_tree_small/mid_bush added to field/forest/night midgrounds (five species in the meadow). mid_moon moved out of the night midground — it is a sky object and SkyDecor owns it now, alongside sky_sun and sky_stars. | 2026-08-13: midgroundWeights added — the meadow reads as broadleaf with the odd conifer (field: oak 5 / big 4 / small 3 / bush 3 / pine 1), not an even mix. The forest keeps more conifer. sky_sun dropped. | 2026-08-13: fruit trees (mid_tree_apple/mid_tree_orange) join the meadow mix. | 2026-08-13: willow/poplar/maple/cherry added — the broadleaf species all had round canopies and read as one repeated tree, so these were chosen for silhouette contrast (drooping, narrow vertical, tiered, blossom). | 2026-08-13: mid_tree_willow dropped — the drooping form did not fit the game's tone (user call). Asset kept on disk in case a later theme wants it. | 2026-08-18: wall theme added and made the opening stage; rotation switched from time-based to every 1500m (sequence wall -> field). Each theme now names its own BGM pair, so the music changes with the stage. | 2026-08-18: BGM roles corrected — Adventure tracks are the normal-run beds, Rush tracks are the fever beds (user spec). Each stage takes one of each so the map still changes the music. | 2026-08-18: displayTitle localised to Korean — it is shown to the player on stage entry, so FIELD/FOREST read as debug labels. | 2026-08-18: obstacleSkins added — the wall stage restyles rock/stump/tree as rubble, barrel and turret. Art only: size, collider and required action stay with the type, so difficulty is unchanged. spike keeps its meadow sprite, which already suits a rampart.
